categories.meaning: Input bytes or source text cannot be read as the expected syntax or artifact format.
A term, statement or declaration is ill typed, including an unresolved or ambiguous inference.
A definition is refused because its totality or termination cannot be established.
A proof, script or term does not establish its stated theorem.
A closed decidable obligation evaluates to false, or a checked counterexample exists.
Automation neither proves nor refutes an obligation within its limits.
A wall-clock ceiling ends the step before it completes.
A memory, recursion, output or size ceiling ends the step, or the tool reports exhausting one.
The candidate cannot express or run a required construct in the tested envelope.
A solver result is used without a checked certificate.
A certificate is rejected by its checker.
A host or target row the case requires is missing or unsupported.
An axiom, plugin, native evaluator or extension outside the declared trust inventory is used.
